```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  summarise(
    mean_mcap = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    days = n()
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(mean_mcap)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
prices <- arrow::read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- arrow::read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- arrow::read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(categories, by = "category_id") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw))
  #| cache: true
```

```{r}
category_shares <- crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarise(
    market_cap_usd = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  complete(date, category_name, fill = list(market_cap_usd = 0)) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  mutate(market_cap_share = market_cap_usd / sum(market_cap_usd)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    category_name = forcats::fct_reorder(
      category_name,
      market_cap_share,
      .fun = median,
      .desc = TRUE
    )
  )

ggplot(category_shares, aes(x = date, y = market_cap_share, fill = category_name)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-05-07"), xmax = as.Date("2022-05-13"),
    ymin = 0, ymax = 1,
    fill = "grey30", alpha = 0.12
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-11-08"), xmax = as.Date("2022-11-12"),
    ymin = 0, ymax = 1,
    fill = "grey30", alpha = 0.12
  ) +
  geom_area(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = as.Date("2022-05-10"), y = 1.045,
    label = "Luna/UST crash",
    size = 3, label.size = 0, fill = "white"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = as.Date("2022-11-10"), y = 1.045,
    label = "FTX collapse",
    size = 3, label.size = 0, fill = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "viridis", end = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.1), clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "Crypto market-cap composition over time",
    subtitle = "Each band shows a category's share of the total market capitalization represented in the daily dataset.",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Share of total market cap",
    fill = "Category",
    caption = "Source: daily_prices.parquet; category labels from coin_metadata.parquet and categories.parquet. Shaded dates mark approximate shock windows."
  )
```
